support_claim: CRM account NBA-102 is recorded as "Northbridge Analytics" while billing uses "Northbridge Analytics Inc.", and commercial notes state that legal has not determined which registry entity is the contracting party and that the registry link should be treated as unresolved.
justification: Under the relation contract, SAME_ENTITY requires establishing evidence of identity and DISTINCT requires establishing evidence of distinctness; the packet only shows compatible name variants across CRM and billing and explicitly records that legal identity cannot be established, so neither positive nor negative disposition is licensed.
